# pluto_policy (Resource)

A Pluto policy, defined exactly as the dashboard's policy editor saves it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Block the GitHub MCP server. Import a policy built in the dashboard to get a full definition to start from.
resource "pluto_policy" "github_mcp" {
  definition = jsonencode({
    type    = "supply-chain"
    name    = "Block the GitHub MCP"
    enabled = true
    conditions = {
      kind = "group", id = "root", conjunction = "and"
      children = [{
        kind   = "condition", id = "c-mcp-1-name", field = "mcp:name", operator = "is"
        values = [{ id = "name:github", label = "github", kind = "mcp_server", resolution = "typed", scope = null }]
      }]
    }
    actions = [{ id = "a-outcome", kind = "block", settings = {} }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) The policy as JSON, in the shape the dashboard's policy editor reads and writes. Pluto validates it with the editor's own rules. Import a policy built in the dashboard to get a definition to start from.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `version` (String) Pluto's version of the policy, sent back on update so a newer change isn't overwritten.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pluto_policy.github_mcp <policy id>
```
